name: python_interpreter
for_role: TCO Modeller and Fleet Feasibility Analyst; Cost Model Verifier
what_it_does: Runs Python 3 / shell in the sandboxed workspace (Bash, Read, Write, Edit) so the model can be run and its script saved, and the verifier can recompute independently.
input: Python code or shell command; file paths
output: stdout and files in the workspace
example_output: markdown TCO table printed; tco_model.py saved

name: docx
what_it_does: Creates a formatted Word .docx (headings, table, numbered list, compact margins/fonts) with python-docx, writes and compares the mandated first paragraph against mandated_line.txt, and counts pages by converting to PDF (soffice headless) when a converter exists. The skill brings its own local tools, so the editor role needs no separate tool entry. Fallback if unfilled: python-docx through a local shell; if no converter exists, the page count is marked unverified with a word/line estimate.
input: Memo text in structured sections plus a table as rows; the mandated line string
output: .docx file in the workspace, mandated_line.txt, page count
example_output: tco_memo.docx (0.7in margins, 10pt), first-paragraph match: true, pages: 2

name: web_search
for_role: Incentives and Tax Policy Researcher; Fleet Cost Data Researcher; Cost Model Verifier
what_it_does: Web search returning snippets with URLs, plus fetch_url for full pages (EIA, IRS, Congress.gov, utility tariffs).
example_input: EIA Indiana commercial electricity price cents per kWh latest month
